title: Vegas Neon removes visible focus from action buttons
reasoning: The Vegas Neon theme suppresses the browser focus outline for every button, but the replacement focus styling that follows is only applied to selects. Deal, Play, and Fold are keyboard-focusable buttons, so keyboard users can tab onto the primary game controls without any visible focus indicator in this theme.
reproduction: Switch to Vegas Neon and tab to Deal, Play, or Fold. The theme sets button outline to none and adds no button-specific focus-visible border, outline, or shadow.
recommendation: In themes/vegas-neon.css, either stop clearing button outlines or add an explicit button:focus-visible style, for example a neon cyan outline/box-shadow with outline-offset. Keep the existing select focus styling.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing node --test test/*.test.js suites passed 119/119, but they cover evaluator, simulator, variants, and explanation logic only. There are no DOM, visual, or accessibility tests for theme focus states.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a browser smoke test that cycles through each theme, tabs through visible controls, and asserts focused buttons have a visible focus indicator such as non-none outline, border change, or focus box-shadow.
